facts.text: Tim mentions that during Thanksgiving, they usually watch a few movies, including 'Home Alone', which brings lots of laughs.

evidence.quote: During Thanksgiving, we usually watch a few movies. We love 'Home Alone' - it always brings lots of laughs!
Watching some movies afterwards - the best!

facts.text: Tim states that they also watch 'Elf' during the holidays, which makes them laugh and feel festive.

evidence.quote: We also watch 'Elf' during the holidays. It makes us laugh and get us feeling festive!
Watching some movies afterwards - the best!

facts.text: Tim adds that they enjoy watching 'The Santa Clause' as well, which is described as heartwarming and festive.

evidence.quote: We love 'The Santa Clause' too- it's so heartwarming and gets us all feeling festive!
Watching some movies afterwards - the best!
